module.news.name: TSQ News (Aurora · HLTV)
module.news.description: Forwards HLTV news about Aurora's main CS2 team from the official RSS feed, once, as headline and link, to the news channel.
news.card.title: 📰 {0} — HLTV

news.doctor.roster_value: {0} · {1} players · verified {2} (valid for at most {3} days)
